speaker: Doctor
text: I note that your initial glucose, thyroid, and ammonia levels are normal, which helps rule out hypoglycemia and metabolic encephalopathy. Given the persistent seizures and lethargy, have you noticed any respiratory distress, such as grunting, flaring, or a persistent cough since birth? REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Blood_Culture. REQUEST TEST: Newborn_CSF_Analysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood culture and CSF analysis results are normal, which makes a severe bacterial sepsis or meningitis less likely. Given the neonate's age, seizures, and lethargy, have you observed any cyanosis, pale skin, or bulging fontanelle? REQUEST TEST: Newborn_EEG. REQUEST IMAGES: Cranial_Imaging.

speaker: Doctor
text: The EEG and cranial imaging results are normal, which makes neonatal sepsis, meningitis, and structural brain abnormalities less likely. Given the timing of onset at three days, have you noticed any jaundice, poor feeding, or excessive sleeping? REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Bilirubin_Level.

speaker: Doctor
text: The bilirubin level is normal, which effectively rules out severe hyperbilirubinemia as the cause of the seizures. With metabolic, infectious, and structural causes excluded, and given the specific timing of onset at three days of life, have you noticed any signs of feeding difficulty, such as poor suck or regurgitation? REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Head_Circumference. REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Bone_Mineral_Density.

speaker: Doctor
text: I have your head circumference and bone mineral density results, which are normal. Since we have ruled out metabolic, infectious, structural, and nutritional causes, and given the specific timing of seizures onset at three days of life, have there been any signs of maternal steroid use, placental issues, or umbilical cord abnormalities? REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Umbilical_Culture. REQUEST TEST: Maternal_Corticosteroid_Levels. REQUEST TEST: Newborn_Chest_X-Ray. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (atypical presentation) or Maternal Corticosteroid Withdrawal Syndrome.
